prompt: In the style of a cinematic film still, the scene captures the chaotic heart of a busy restaurant kitchen. On the left stands a chef in a white toque, gripping a heavy cast iron skillet with a firm hand. Next to him is a sous chef in blue apron, wiping sweat from his brow with a rag. A line cook in stained whites stirs a bubbling pot vigorously on the stove. Beside the stove sits a wooden cutting board holding a sharp knife and a pile of diced onions. Above them hangs a rack of copper pans gleaming under the heat. In the center, a waiter in a black vest balances a silver tray laden with three steaming plates. He looks intently at the expeditor in a crisp shirt who points urgently toward the pass. The expeditor holds a ticket printer that spits out long paper strips. Near the pass, a dishwasher in rubber gloves scrubs a stack of ceramic bowls. A busboy in grey t-shirt carries a bin of dirty glassware past the sink. On the right, a health inspector in a suit observes the chaos with a clipboard in hand. Behind him leans a tall fridge humming loudly against the wall. A small brown dog peeks out from under a prep table near the dog's water bowl. The dog watches a rat scurry along the baseboard near a trash can. A fly buzzes around a hanging light bulb above the prep area. A potted basil plant sits on the windowsill catching the afternoon sun. The head chef yells instructions while gesturing with a ladle toward the oven. The oven door stands slightly ajar revealing glowing embers inside. There is no digital clock visible on the wall. There is no smartphone in anyone's hand. There is no window showing the outside street.
